what_this_is: Pages the scorers note went to, or pages that already describe this store, watched every Sunday for the day one starts carrying a row of the corpus — a verify URL, a corpus entry or host URL, or the cite shape. A prospect is not a citing system: nothing here is rendered on /scorers. When the watch finds a citation on one of these pages it pages the keeper, and the keeper moves the entry to src/store/citing-systems.json by hand if it meets the five listing facts there.
shape: name, url, and the date noted. Nothing else — no status, no contact, no send date; the send ledger is the keeper's own sheet.
